facts: Root reviewed current CUA documentation: macOS getApp screenshots are scoped to app windows, with no documented full-desktop capture or audio transcription API.
Root previously attempted getApp for the running VoiceOver app and it timed out. Safari app screenshot omitted the separate caption panel.
Actual spoken/caption words therefore remain unobserved. No announcement may be inferred from Safari AX text.
disposition: Assess a documented allowed safe observable method first, without system-app modification or disclosure of unrelated clipboard/desktop content. If unavailable, a real participant/user report of actual utterances is needed. Remaining keyboard/source-focus/List/theme/narrow observations can be prepared separately, but full TASK022 stays incomplete.
